title: London-based Inforcer, which helps managed service providers handle their clients' Microsoft 365 accounts, raised a $50M Series C led by Insight Partners (Dominic-Madori Davis/TechCrunch)
summary: Dominic-Madori Davis / TechCrunch: London-based Inforcer, which helps managed service providers handle their clients' Microsoft 365 accounts, raised a $50M Series C led by Insight Partners — London-based Inforcer announced Thursday a $50 million Series C round led by Insight Partners — the latest sign of investor interest …
